div.div:
Why it feels instantaneous
These are scheduled feedback calculations on local hardware. Crazyswarm reports an onboard 500 Hz loop (2 ms period) for its indoor platform.
EGO-Swarm reports millisecond trajectory optimization in its experiments. Neither is a universal outdoor operating rate.
